occurrenceChecks.text: Of Issachar: Nethanel the son of Zuar.
occurrenceChecks.reasonJa: 固定WEB本文に対象名を明記。

occurrenceChecks.text: “Those who encamp next to him shall be the tribe of Issachar. The prince of the children of Issachar shall be Nethanel the son of Zuar.
occurrenceChecks.reasonJa: 固定WEB本文に対象名を明記。

occurrenceChecks.text: On the second day Nethanel the son of Zuar, prince of Issachar, gave his offering.
occurrenceChecks.reasonJa: 固定WEB本文に対象名を明記。

occurrenceChecks.text: and for the sacrifice of peace offerings, two head of cattle, five rams, five male goats, five male lambs a year old. This was the offering of Nethanel the son of Zuar.
occurrenceChecks.reasonJa: 固定WEB本文に対象名を明記。

occurrenceChecks.text: Nethanel the son of Zuar was over the army of the tribe of the children of Issachar.
occurrenceChecks.reasonJa: 固定WEB本文に対象名を明記。
